title: Exodus 16:3, 32:8 and 17:2 — Israel complains, makes a calf, and quarrels with Moses
summary: Three Exodus verses in English with Hebrew reference headers: the people wish they had died in Egypt rather than starve in the wilderness (16:3), they have made themselves a molten calf (32:8), and they quarrel with Moses, who asks why they test the LORD (17:2).

text.text: 3 “Would that we had died by the LORD’S hand in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the pots of meat, when we ate bread to the full; for you have brought us out into this wilderness to kill this whole assembly with hunger.”
8 They have made for themselves a molten calf,
2 Therefore the people quarreled with Moses and said, “Give us water that we may drink.” And Moses said to them, “Why do you quarrel with me? Why do you test the LORD?”

keywords: died in the land of Egypt
why do you test the LORD
uncertain: The first Hebrew reference header is written with the letters יו (10+6) for chapter 16, as shown on the slide, rather than the usual טז.
